changeWaits.heading: Change to confirm
changeWaits.what: A change to the shop's settings waits for a manager to confirm it.
changeWaits.next: Check it with the owner, then open Change to confirm in Settings.

changeConfirmed.heading: Change confirmed
changeConfirmed.what: The owner phone sends the change to every counter. It applies once it arrives.

notSetUp.heading: Not set up yet
notSetUp.what: This counter has not been paired with the shop yet, so it cannot take a sale.
notSetUp.next: Type a name for the counter, the manager's name and a PIN. Then tap Pair with the shop and scan the code on the owner phone or the Key app.

pairingSaved.heading: Counter set up
pairingSaved.what: The counter is paired with the shop. This device takes payments for you. Only your keys can send.
pairingSaved.next: Keep the app open at the counter. It starts looking for the network now.

pairingScanOffer.heading: Scan the shop's code
pairingScanOffer.what: The owner phone or the Key app shows a code for a new counter. This counter reads the shop's wallet and network from it.
pairingScanOffer.next: Open Add a counter on the owner phone, or Pair a counter on the Key app. Then tap Scan and hold this phone's camera to its code.

pairingCompare.heading: Compare the four words
pairingCompare.what: The Key app shows four words for this pairing, and the same four are below. If they are not the same, someone changed the code on the way.
pairingCompare.next: Check all four words on the Key app, then tap They match, or tap They differ if any word is not the same.

pairingScanBundle.heading: Scan the owner's phone
pairingScanBundle.what: The four words matched. The owner's phone now shows the code that finishes the pairing.
pairingScanBundle.next: On the owner's phone open the counter's code, then tap Scan and hold this phone's camera to it.

pairingForgotten.heading: Pairing not finished
pairingForgotten.what: The app was closed or left before the pairing was finished, so it was forgotten and nothing was saved.
pairingForgotten.next: Start again from the Key app: open Pair a counter, then tap Pair on this counter and scan its code.

pairingOwnAddress.heading: Check your wallet
pairingOwnAddress.what: This is the first receive address of the wallet the owner phone gave this counter. Every sale's address will come from this wallet.
pairingOwnAddress.next: Open your wallet and find its first receive address. Tap Same address only if every character is the same. Otherwise tap Different.

pairingOwnDifferent.heading: Different wallet
pairingOwnDifferent.what: The address on this counter is not your wallet's first address, so the owner phone gave this counter a different wallet. Nothing was saved.
pairingOwnDifferent.next: Check that the owner phone has your wallet, then start the pairing again from the owner phone.

pairingOwnCompare.heading: Compare the four words
pairingOwnCompare.what: The owner phone shows four words too. When they are the same as these, neither code was changed on the way.
pairingOwnCompare.next: Check all four words on the owner phone, then tap They match, or tap They differ if any word is not the same.

pairingOwnForgotten.heading: Pairing not finished
pairingOwnForgotten.what: The app was left before the pairing with the shop's wallet was finished, so it was forgotten and nothing was saved.
pairingOwnForgotten.next: Start again from the owner phone: open Add a counter, then tap Pair on this counter and scan its code.

counterNameNotAccepted.heading: Counter name not accepted
counterNameNotAccepted.what: The name of this counter is 1 to 32 characters long, so it was not used.
counterNameNotAccepted.next: Type a shorter name for this counter, then tap Pair with the shop again.

pinNotAccepted.heading: PIN not accepted
pinNotAccepted.what: A PIN is 6 to 12 digits, and the two entries must be the same, so nothing was saved.
pinNotAccepted.next: Type a PIN of 6 to 12 digits twice, then save again.

nameNotAccepted.heading: Name not accepted
nameNotAccepted.what: A name is 1 to 64 characters long, so it was not saved.

torAddressNotAccepted.heading: Tor address not accepted
torAddressNotAccepted.what: The address of Orbot must be a host, a colon and a port, like 127.0.0.1:9050.

torIsOn.heading: Tor is on for this shop
torIsOn.what: The shop's settings send every connection of this counter through Tor.
torIsOn.next: Nothing to do. The manager can choose how under Tor.

torIsOff.heading: Tor is off for this shop
torIsOff.what: The shop's settings do not use Tor, so the price sources and the network can see this shop's address.
torIsOff.next: Nothing to do here. The owner can switch Tor on in the shop's settings.

orbotNotRunning.heading: Orbot is off
orbotNotRunning.what: Tor is on for this shop, and this counter uses the Orbot app for it, but Orbot is not running.
orbotNotRunning.next: Open the Orbot app, turn it on, then come back here. If Orbot listens at another address, the manager can change it under Network.

torBuiltIn.heading: Tor
torBuiltIn.what: This app runs Tor itself, so Orbot is not needed.
torBuiltIn.next: Nothing to do. To use Orbot instead, choose Use Orbot.

torUsesOrbot.heading: Tor through Orbot
torUsesOrbot.what: This app sends everything through Orbot, which must be installed and running.
torUsesOrbot.next: Keep Orbot running. To stop needing it, choose Built-in Tor.

torStarting.heading: Starting Tor
torStarting.what: This counter is connecting to the Tor network. It can take up to a minute, so open the app a few minutes before the first sale.

torFailed.heading: Tor did not start
torFailed.what: This app could not connect to the Tor network.
torFailed.next: Check that the phone is online, then try again. If it keeps failing, choose Use Orbot.

networkAbout.heading: Network
networkAbout.what: When the shop's settings turn Tor on and this counter uses Orbot, it sends everything through Orbot, at the address below.
networkAbout.next: Change the address only if Orbot listens somewhere else, then type the manager's PIN.

networkSaved.heading: Address saved
networkSaved.what: The counter will look for Orbot at the new address when it uses Orbot.
networkSaved.next: Tap Start to use it now.

ownNodeAbout.heading: Your own node
ownNodeAbout.what: A node of your own, reached by a Tor address, can check each payment as well as the light check does.
ownNodeAbout.next: Type its Tor address and the manager's PIN, then save.

ownNodeSaved.heading: Own node saved
ownNodeSaved.what: The counter will ask your own node about each payment, once it has started again.
ownNodeSaved.next: Wait a moment while the counter starts again.

ownNodeRemoved.heading: Own node removed
ownNodeRemoved.what: The counter checks payments with the light check only.
ownNodeRemoved.next: Wait a moment while the counter starts again.

lightningAbout.heading: Lightning through your node
lightningAbout.what: The counter only asks your node for invoices, so give it a key limited to invoices, from a node that runs a current release.
lightningAbout.next: Scan or paste the LND code, or fill in the three Core Lightning fields, type the manager's PIN, then test and save.

lightningCare.heading: Running a Lightning node
lightningCare.what: A node that takes payments needs channels with room to receive, updates kept current and a backup of its own.
lightningCare.next: Watch the channel balances, install each update soon after it comes out, and keep a backup of the node.

lightningTesting.heading: Testing the node
lightningTesting.what: The counter is asking your node for a test invoice and checking that it is yours.
lightningTesting.next: Wait a moment while the node answers.

lightningFieldsNeeded.heading: Lightning fields needed
lightningFieldsNeeded.what: The connection needs its code, or for Core Lightning its address, its key and its certificate.
lightningFieldsNeeded.next: Fill them in, then test and save again.

lightningNotReached.heading: Test did not finish
lightningNotReached.what: Your node gave no answer the counter could use, so nothing was saved.
lightningNotReached.next: Check the address and that the node is running, then try again.

lightningSaved.heading: Lightning saved
lightningSaved.what: The test passed, and the connection is saved on this phone where only this app can read it.
lightningSaved.next: Wait a moment while the counter starts again.

lightningRemoved.heading: Lightning removed
lightningRemoved.what: The connection to your node is deleted from this phone, and sales show the on-chain code only.

lightningWaiting.heading: Lightning code coming
lightningWaiting.what: The counter is asking the shop's node for a Lightning code for this sale.
lightningWaiting.next: Let the customer pay on-chain with the code above, or wait a few seconds.

managerNeeded.heading: A manager is needed
managerNeeded.what: This step needs the manager's PIN.
managerNeeded.next: Ask the manager to type the PIN.

pinWrong.heading: Wrong PIN
pinWrong.what: That PIN is not right, so nothing was done.

pinLocked.heading: PIN locked for now
pinLocked.what: There were wrong tries in a row, so the PIN is locked for a while.

staffPinNeeded.heading: Manager's PIN needed
staffPinNeeded.what: The list of cashiers is changed only with the manager's PIN.
staffPinNeeded.next: Type the manager's PIN, then tap Open.

staffAbout.heading: Staff
staffAbout.what: Cashiers sign in at the till with their name and PIN. Each one added or removed is written down for the owner.
staffAbout.next: Add a cashier below, or remove one, or give one a new PIN.

cashierNameNotAccepted.heading: Cashier name not accepted
cashierNameNotAccepted.what: A cashier's name is 1 to 24 characters long, with no space at either end, so it was not used.
cashierNameNotAccepted.next: Type another name, then add the cashier again.

cashierNameUsed.heading: Name already used
cashierNameUsed.what: Another cashier or the manager has that name, whatever the capital letters, so it was not used.
cashierNameUsed.next: Type a different name, then add the cashier again.

cashiersFull.heading: Cashier list is full
cashiersFull.what: The list holds at most 30 cashiers, so no one more can be added.
cashiersFull.next: Remove a cashier first, then add the new one.

cashierPinNotAccepted.heading: Cashier PIN not accepted
cashierPinNotAccepted.what: A cashier's PIN is 4 to 8 digits, and the two entries must be the same, so nothing was saved.
cashierPinNotAccepted.next: Type the PIN twice, then save again.

cashierAdded.heading: Cashier added
cashierAdded.what: The cashier is on the list, and the owner's phone gets a record of it.
cashierAdded.next: Sign in at the till with the name and the PIN.

cashierRemoved.heading: Cashier removed
cashierRemoved.what: The cashier is off the list and can no longer sign in, and the owner's phone gets a record of it.

cashierPinSaved.heading: New PIN saved
cashierPinSaved.what: The cashier's new PIN is saved on this phone. Nothing about it is sent to the owner.
cashierPinSaved.next: Sign in at the till with the new PIN.

ownerNotTold.heading: Owner not told
ownerNotTold.what: The list of cashiers was changed, but the record for the owner could not be written.
ownerNotTold.next: Tell the owner in person that the list changed.

cashiersNotRead.heading: Cashier list not read
cashiersNotRead.what: The list of cashiers could not be read, so nobody can sign in and nothing was done.
cashiersNotRead.next: Try again. If it happens again, stop and tell the owner in person.

whoAtTill.heading: Who is at the till?
whoAtTill.what: The till is locked, so no sale can be opened until a person signs in.
whoAtTill.next: Tap your name, then type your PIN.

signInWrong.heading: PIN not right
signInWrong.what: That PIN is not the one for this name, so nobody was signed in.

signInHeld.heading: PIN held for now
signInHeld.what: There were wrong tries in a row on this name, so its PIN is held for a while.
signInHeld.next: Wait 5 minutes, then try again, or tap Back and pick another name.

overrideAbout.heading: Accept by hand
overrideAbout.what: Accepting a sale by hand is written down with the name of the person who does it, and the limits apply to each person.
overrideAbout.next: Tap Accept, or choose the manager and type the manager's PIN.

todayAbout.heading: Today at this counter
todayAbout.what: These totals are counted from this counter's own records since midnight. No wallet balance is shown here.
todayAbout.next: The owner's phone has the full books and the export.

todayWaiting.heading: Why sales are waiting
todayWaiting.what: A sale waits until its payment is accepted: it may be unpaid, part paid, or paid and not yet confirmed.
todayWaiting.next: Open the sale from Sales to see which. The count changes once the payment is accepted or the sale ends.

todayStopped.heading: Sales not to be handed over
todayStopped.what: A payment for these sales was replaced or reopened, so the goods are not to be handed over.
todayStopped.next: Open the sale from Sales and follow what it says.

todayPeopleNeedPin.heading: Lines per person
todayPeopleNeedPin.what: The lines per person show who opened each sale and did each override or refund, so they need the manager's PIN.
todayPeopleNeedPin.next: Type the manager's PIN, then tap Show the lines.

priceReady.heading: Price ready
priceReady.what: Bitcoin is priced at 73,554.18 USD, from 3 price sources.
priceReady.next: Nothing to do. The app asks the sources again every minute.

sourceNotAnswered.heading: Price source not reached
sourceNotAnswered.what: A price source did not answer in time, so its price is missing this turn.
sourceNotAnswered.next: Nothing to do. The app asks again in a minute.

sourceRefusedStatus.heading: Price source said no
sourceRefusedStatus.what: A price source answered with a refusal, so its price is missing this turn.
sourceRefusedStatus.next: Nothing to do. The app asks again in a minute.

sourceReplyTooLong.heading: Price reply too long
sourceReplyTooLong.what: A price source sent more than the app reads, so its price is missing this turn.
sourceReplyTooLong.next: Nothing to do. The app asks again in a minute.

amountNeeded.heading: Amount needed
amountNeeded.what: Type an amount above zero to start a sale.
amountNeeded.next: Press the digits of the amount, then press Open.

tipChoose.heading: Add a tip?
tipChoose.what: The sale is 12.50 USD. A tip goes to the shop with it.
tipChoose.next: Choose a tip, or No tip.

cameraOff.heading: Camera is off for this app
cameraOff.what: This app is not allowed to use the camera, and pairing needs it to read the codes, so nothing was paired.
cameraOff.next: Allow the camera for this app in the phone's settings, then start the pairing again.

cameraNotStarted.heading: Camera did not start
cameraNotStarted.what: The camera could not be opened, so no code was read and nothing was paired.
cameraNotStarted.next: Close any other app that uses the camera, then start the pairing again.

notANumber.heading: Check what you typed
notANumber.what: The amount is empty or has something other than digits in it.
notANumber.next: Type whole numbers only, then try again.

nameNeeded.heading: Name needed
nameNeeded.what: A refund or an override is written down with the name of the person who asked for it.
nameNeeded.next: Type your name on the home screen, then try again.

destinationNeeded.heading: Address needed
destinationNeeded.what: A refund needs the address the customer wants the money sent to.
destinationNeeded.next: Paste the address or the payment request the customer shows, then try again.

reasonNeeded.heading: Reason needed
reasonNeeded.what: A refund is written down with the reason for it.
reasonNeeded.next: Type a short reason, then try again.

requestCopied.heading: Request copied
requestCopied.what: The payment request is copied, written in lower case.
requestCopied.next: Paste it where the customer can use it.

requestMade.heading: Request ready
requestMade.what: The customer can pay this request from anywhere until 2026-11-14 10:00. The amount in bitcoin is fixed at 73,554 sats.
requestMade.next: Share the link or the code with the customer. The counter shows Paid once the payment is confirmed.

requestOpen.heading: Waiting for payment
requestOpen.what: This request is open until 2026-11-14 10:00. It is paid once the payment is confirmed.

refundAsked.heading: Refund asked for
refundAsked.what: The refund request is saved, and it is paid only after the owner approves it.
refundAsked.next: Nothing more to do here. Tell the customer the owner pays refunds from the owner's phone.

refundWithdrawn.heading: Refund withdrawn
refundWithdrawn.what: The withdrawal is sent to the owner. A refund the owner has already started approving may still be paid.
refundWithdrawn.next: Do not give it in cash until the owner says it was dropped.

lightningRefundCash.heading: Refund in cash
lightningRefundCash.what: This sale was paid over Lightning, and the owner's phone can only check payments it sees on the chain, so a bitcoin refund cannot be sent.
lightningRefundCash.next: Give the refund in cash from the till.

cashRefunded.heading: Cash refund saved
cashRefunded.what: The cash refund from the till is written down, and the bitcoin is kept.

starting.heading: Starting
starting.what: The counter is starting and looking for the network.
starting.next: Wait a moment. Keep the app open.

stopped.heading: Counter stopped
stopped.what: The counter has stopped, so no sale can be opened.
stopped.next: Close the app and open it again. If it stays stopped, take another kind of payment.

libraryMissing.heading: The app is incomplete
libraryMissing.what: The part of this app that runs the counter did not load, so nothing was done.
libraryMissing.next: Do not use this copy. Install the app again from the place you got it.

fault.heading: Answer not readable
fault.what: The app could not read an answer from the counter part, so nothing was changed.
fault.next: Close the app and open it again. If it happens again, stop and tell the owner in person.

storageUnavailable.heading: Phone storage not usable
storageUnavailable.what: The phone's protected storage did not start, so the saved pairing was not opened.
storageUnavailable.next: Restart the phone and open this app again. If it happens again, stop and tell the owner in person.

fileNotRead.heading: File not read
fileNotRead.what: The file could not be opened or read, so nothing was done.
fileNotRead.next: Try again. If it happens again, stop and tell the owner in person.

fileNotSaved.heading: Not saved
fileNotSaved.what: The app could not write to this phone's storage, so nothing was saved.
fileNotSaved.next: Try again. If it happens again, stop and tell the owner in person.

UrWords.reading.heading: Reading the animated code
UrWords.reading.what: Reading the animated code: 3 of about 9 parts.
UrWords.reading.next: Keep the phone pointed at the code until it is done.

UrWords.restarted.heading: Code did not add up
UrWords.restarted.what: The parts read did not fit together, so reading starts again.
UrWords.restarted.next: Keep the phone pointed at the code. It reads from the first part again.

UrWords.otherCode.heading: Another code is in view
UrWords.otherCode.what: The code in view is not part of the one being read, so it is skipped.
UrWords.otherCode.next: Point the phone at the first code again, or cancel and start over.

UrWords.wrongKind.heading: Not the code expected
UrWords.wrongKind.what: This code carries something this step does not take, so nothing was used.
UrWords.wrongKind.next: Cancel, then ask for the right code again, or use a file instead.

UrWords.contentRefused.heading: Code content not usable
UrWords.contentRefused.what: The code was read in full, but what it holds is not in a form this step takes.
UrWords.contentRefused.next: Ask for the code to be shown again, or use a file instead.

UrWords.readerFailed.heading: Code reader failed
UrWords.readerFailed.what: The part of this app that reads codes gave no usable answer, so nothing was read.
UrWords.readerFailed.next: Close the app and open it again. If it happens again, use a file.
